posts.name: overads.io
posts.tagline: Marketing and GTM that run while you sleep
posts.description: overads runs marketing and GTM for founders, end to end. Describe a job once and it becomes a workflow that runs every week. It writes, designs and schedules posts for Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X and Pinterest. It watches your Meta and Google ads, and you can pause a campaign or move a budget right from chat. GTMgenie runs your outbound on email and LinkedIn. Nothing goes out without your yes. One plan, $59/month.

posts.name: RetainIQ
posts.tagline: Know which customers need attention, why & what to do next
posts.description: RetainIQ shows B2B SaaS teams which customers need attention, why, and what to do next, ranked by revenue at risk. Every recommendation comes with the evidence behind it, so your team can act with confidence. Recover prioritizes failed payments. Retain shows churn evidence and confidence. Reactivate finds dormant customers worth contacting. Start free for 15 days, no credit card.

posts.name: Tano
posts.tagline: Korean vocabulary app that skips the words you know
posts.description: Tano is an iPhone app for learning Korean vocabulary. A short level check skips the words you already know. Then you get a few new words a day, each with an example sentence and sound, and reviews tomorrow, in 3 days and in a week. Words come sorted into 20 real-life situations and 53 topics. Practice by choosing the meaning, filling in the sentence or writing in Hangul, while your avatar grows from 아기 to 어른. Free to start, no account needed.

posts.name: Superrelay
posts.tagline: One inbox for every app you ship, never priced per ticket
posts.description: One support workspace for teams shipping several apps: chat, email, WhatsApp, Slack and in-app in one inbox. An AI agent that cites sources and asks before acting, GitHub-synced docs, and a CLI/MCP so coding agents read tickets. Never priced per ticket.

posts.name: Dex Telemetry
posts.tagline: Open-source Datadog for analytics
posts.description: You set up analytics to monitor your business. But who's monitoring your analytics? Dex Telemetry gives you observability for your pipelines, with rules and context built for your agents.

posts.name: Slopie
posts.tagline: A free 3D map of every ski resort, in your browser
posts.description: Slopie shows more than 4,000 ski resorts in 69 countries in 3D, with every run and lift on the real terrain. The whole map is free in any browser, with no account. The iPhone and Apple Watch app records your ski days on the same map.

posts.name: GrayPass
posts.tagline: Verify who’s in control before agents make sensitive actions
posts.description: Login tools tell you who signed in. GrayPass verifies who’s still in control when it actually matters. Before a wire, payout change, admin grant, or other sensitive action executes, GrayPass uses behavioral and session evidence to decide whether to allow, re-verify, hold, or deny it. Its Brainprint learns how each person types, moves, and scrolls without capturing what they type, adding fresh assurance without forcing MFA on every user.

posts.name: NOVA
posts.tagline: Development to deployment, and everything after.
posts.description: Building is the easy part. NOVA handles what comes after: hosting, your own domain, search and AI-search readiness, version history, team editing, and a one-command handover to a developer's terminal. One account, one plan, from development to deployment.

posts.name: airoom
posts.tagline: An open-source control room for your Claude Code agents
posts.description: Every project is a room and every Claude Code session is a desk. See who is working, who is waiting on you and who is stuck. Chat, approve commands, hire a team, or let an agent test your app in the built-in browser. Free, local and open source.

posts.name: Microsoft-Decision-1.1
posts.tagline: Microsoft's decision model: calibrated, 2x faster, now GA
posts.description: Microsoft-Decision-1.1 is a decision model, trained to make reliable choices inside software instead of writing text. It picks from permitted actions, reports confidence so apps can defer when unsure, and now accepts images. Per Microsoft, it is over 2x faster than v1 at about the same cost, and scores 68 on the Artificial Analysis Decision Index. Generally available on Microsoft Foundry, OpenRouter and Vercel after a public preview last month.

posts.name: Bento
posts.tagline: Runnable lessons and interactive maps of GitHub repos
posts.description: Bento is a free, open-source Mac app for learning how software works. Get runnable lessons from questions or take apart GitHub repos. It uses the AI subscription you already have. Try ready-made lessons and featured repos in your browser, no install.

posts.name: Cognition SWE-2.1
posts.tagline: A long-horizon coding model with a 10x faster Ultrafast mode
posts.description: SWE-2.1 is Cognition's upgraded coding model, trained with pure reinforcement learning on Kimi K3 for long-horizon work. Per Cognition, FrontierCode 2.0 rose from 24.1 to 41.3, Terminal-Bench 4.1 from 24.2 to 50.0 and ExploitBench from 36.1 to 80.0. SWE-2.1 Ultrafast runs about 10x faster with Cerebras. Available in Devin Desktop, Cloud and CLI, free through December 8 on Desktop and CLI.

posts.name: OpenCrawl
posts.tagline: Multiplayer for your coding agents
posts.description: OpenCrawl lets your coding agents search each other's histories and talk to each other, across laptops and cloud coding environments. Works with Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini CLI and more. Open source, self-hostable and free to start.

posts.name: DearDarling
posts.tagline: A couples messenger with a mutual friend, Pip
posts.description: One of the attractions at DearMate, a virtual AI theme park. A private messenger for two, with Pip: a mutual friend who knows your chat, gives one tip when you ask, and talks to each of you alone without taking sides. Every night, your day becomes a page.

posts.name: Tallhorn
posts.tagline: A native MongoDB® client where AI agents ask before writing
posts.description: Tallhorn is a fast, native MongoDB® client for Mac, built with SwiftUI and AppKit. Browse documents as a table, tree or JSON, script queries in JavaScript, build pipelines stage by stage, read explain plans, and turn queries into dashboards. A built-in MCP server lets Claude Code, Cursor and VS Code query your databases under rules you set per connection, and by default every agent write waits for your approval. No account, no analytics. Free; Pro adds dashboards and agents, $29.99 once.

posts.name: Stacktrace
posts.tagline: Real-time steering and guardrails for AI agents
posts.description: Stacktrace is a control layer for AI agents such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Devin. It reads their tool calls, blocks unsafe ones before they run, enforces the limits your team sets and steps in when an agent drifts from its intent.

posts.name: gutcheck
posts.tagline: Check your gut against the internet, inside Claude Code
posts.description: Before you build it, find out if anyone wants it. Type /gutcheck and an idea, a problem or a decision in Claude Code. It plans a study, pulls live evidence from Google Trends, Google News, Hacker News, GitHub, the App Store, Wikipedia and the web, and gives you a verdict: how sure it is, the case against, and what to do this week. No API keys to start. Runs on your machine. Free and open source.

posts.name: ro
posts.tagline: I won't bother you
posts.description: ro sits quietly on your Mac desktop or menu bar and stays out of your way. Free as a desktop pet that reacts to your apps. Unlock Pro for local file search (⌥R), Downloads cleanup with undo, and private AI handoff. Nothing leaves your Mac.

posts.name: Wender Desktop
posts.tagline: A 100% free Paper alternative
posts.description: Wender Desktop is a 100% free HTML canvas design tool for Mac. Use your own agent subscriptions, own your files forever and self host on a free Cloudflare plan for sharing and collaboration, and work with your real code and components. No MCP limits. No seat limits.

posts.name: RankTheSearch
posts.tagline: Make the TikTok posts your buyers are already searching for
posts.description: Nearly half of US consumers now use TikTok as a search engine (Adobe, 2026). Paste your product link and RankTheSearch finds the searches where today's answers are weak, rates each one from 0 to 100, then makes the slideshows and videos that answer them.

posts.name: Tote
posts.tagline: Help your AI find real Black Friday deals in your size
posts.description: A free add-on for ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, and Gemini. Tell your AI your sizes and taste once, find real Black Friday deals with 90 days of price history, and get Deal Watch emails when prices drop. Tote never buys for you: you always check out yourself.

posts.name: OfficeBats
posts.tagline: The online AI office suite, eleven apps for one price
posts.description: OfficeBats is an all-in-one AI-powered workspace to create documents, spreadsheets and presentations, edit PDFs, design websites and graphics, collect e-signatures, manage finances, build forms and handle customer support, all with integrated cloud storage and AI assistance.

posts.name: Purgy
posts.tagline: Deep-clean your Mac: hidden files, System Data and AI models
posts.description: Purgy finds what macOS hides: System Data, app leftovers, hidden folders, and unused AI models, and frees the safe part in one click. It also checks the important security settings of your Mac. Try it free for 3 days, then pay $20 once and use it for life.

posts.name: Reeltopus
posts.tagline: Topus, the 8-armed video agent: research, make, post, grow
posts.description: Tell Topus what you want, or let Claude, ChatGPT or Cursor drive him over MCP. He finds what your niche searches for and which videos are breaking out, makes clips, reels and carousels from anything, edits by chat with undo on every step, tests titles and thumbnails, and posts to 9 platforms once you approve. A 4-hour video is ready in as little as 3.6 min.

posts.name: Sqrin
posts.tagline: A better screen share for your Mac
posts.description: Sqrin makes your live screen shares stand out like polished, pre-recorded videos. You keep working on your normal screen, while viewers see a zoomed, cropped view that follows your mouse, with a large pointer they can actually see. With Auto Zoom mode, you don't even have to control the zoom – the app does it for you. Works with Zoom, Meet, Teams or any other meeting app. No plugins or integrations.

posts.name: Lyric Boost
posts.tagline: Songwriting workspace for music artists
posts.description: Lyric Boost is a lyric writing app and songwriting workspace for music artists to move songs forward. Whether you're capturing melody ideas, writing lyrics or finalizing your song for release, Lyric Boost has got you covered.

posts.name: Lathoa
posts.tagline: Kids learn critical thinking by catching an AI's mistakes
posts.description: Kids are growing up with AI that sounds sure of itself even when it's wrong. Lathoa trains the skill that matters: noticing. Errol, a friendly robot, solves a math problem step by step and slips in one mistake on purpose. Kids aged 10 to 14 find the wrong step and explain what went wrong. Sometimes nothing is wrong, so guessing doesn't pay. Every case ends with the right answer. Parents see what their kid catches. Free for 3 cases a day, in English, German and Greek.

posts.name: Samesake
posts.tagline: Match customer records across systems without a shared ID
posts.description: Samesake links customer records that belong to the same person, even when names, contact details or customer IDs differ. Review uncertain matches side by side and see why they were suggested. Each system keeps its own records, and your applications and workflows can use a shared person ID. Find linked records for GDPR subject access requests and track erasure across connected systems.

posts.name: DSpace360 Studio Website & SEO Grader
posts.tagline: Instant SEO Diagnostic
posts.description: Run an instant, zero-limit diagnostic on your interior design or architecture website across Speed, SEO, Mobile Conversion, and AI Search (GEO) readiness.

posts.name: ParikshaLens
posts.tagline: Provide alerts to students related to Indian Comp. Exams
posts.description: Indian Government Portals are messy, and I've gone through it too, so the solution is simple, deliver notifications to you about your important exams to you being as fast as 7-8 minutes within the release of notifications. The product tries to be super accurate, providing all official sources for each notification on your desired app(telegram, email, discord), with support for big communities. The product is for students and therefore kept very cheap since I know how conservative we are.

posts.name: MyStreets.ai
posts.tagline: Street rankings for real estate
posts.description: Home valuations are everywhere. Street rankings give homeowners a new reason to look. “My neighbor’s home took months to sell—but mine has better upgrades and a bigger lot.” That comparison is already happening. MyStreets turns it into an experience homeowners can explore, revisit, and ask questions about. Real estate agents bring it to their communities through branded reports and exclusive addresses—turning neighborhood curiosity into conversations with potential sellers.

posts.name: Norwegian 4x4 Protocol App
posts.tagline: Norwegian 4x4 Protocol: VO2 Max HIIT App & Interval Timer
posts.description: Guided Norwegian 4x4 Protocol app: four 4-minute HIIT intervals at 85-95% HRmax with 3-minute active recoveries, heart rate zone tracking and a 25-minute session built to raise VO2 max. Celebrating 3 year anniversary!

posts.name: Appstronaut
posts.tagline: Ship, track & reply to your iOS apps from an Android phone
posts.description: Appstronaut brings App Store Connect to Android. Get alerts when builds finish, reviews land or your app's review status changes. See daily sales trends, edit What's New and keywords, and handle TestFlight. All direct with Apple using your own API key, no server.

posts.name: InProQu
posts.tagline: Write proposals in Claude or ChatGPT, clients sign one link
posts.description: Write proposals and quotes inside Claude or ChatGPT over MCP, or in a new block editor built for proposals, with your own AI key. Then send one link. Your client reads it like a website on any device, picks a plan, switches add-ons on or off, watches the total update and signs right there. You see every view and decision, and an accepted deal becomes an invoice, then a receipt. On web, iOS and Android.

posts.name: Hypeclip
posts.tagline: Turn your product URL into a launch video in minutes
posts.description: Paste your product's URL. Hypeclip captures your site, writes the script, and builds a 16-second launch video with original music in landscape, vertical and square. Pick from 5 templates, edit the text, colors and track, and preview it free in your browser. One credit exports all three formats in HD plus 5 Product Hunt gallery images. Built for indie makers and small teams launching on Product Hunt, X, LinkedIn, Reels and TikTok.

posts.name: Riff
posts.tagline: AI-driven investor perspectives on 6 stories every 6 hours
posts.description: See what an investor might notice in today’s news. Riff uses AI to look at real news stories through the ideas investors have shared publicly, showing what they might pay attention to and why. You can check the sources behind each take.

posts.name: SPECTRALE
posts.tagline: Architecture intelligence for AI-speed software
posts.description: SPECTRALE discovers and maps technical systems from the entry points you provide, building a navigable architecture view from available evidence.

posts.name: SeraShield
posts.tagline: Encrypted photo & file vault for Android. No account.
posts.description: SeraShield is an encrypted vault for photos, videos and documents on Android. Files are encrypted on your phone with AES-256-GCM, file names and thumbnails included. No account, no ads, no tracking, and it works offline. Unlock with a passphrase, PIN, pattern or biometrics, take private photos straight into the vault and keep encrypted backups. Launch offer: install in the first 72 hours and get SeraShield Pro free, forever.

posts.name: KotoPorbe
posts.tagline: Live laptop & phone prices across 15 Bangladesh shops
posts.description: Buying gadgets in Bangladesh is a guessing game — every shop lists a different price and "in stock" is often a lie. KotoPorbe scrapes ~15 shops every night and shows the real current price for laptops and phones, with price history. No ads, no store — just prices.

posts.name: McBot Studio
posts.tagline: AI agents that stay yours
posts.description: Build a team of AI agents on your computer, with any model, local or cloud. Switch models in one click and your agents keep their memory. Free and open source.

posts.name: Beachball Island
posts.tagline: Turn your Mac into an air hockey table
posts.description: The first game built for Touch on Mac! Play solo or duo. Compatible with trackpad, or with Sidecar iPads.

posts.name: Hirecarta 2.0
posts.tagline: Job search like a recruiter
posts.description: Recruiters screen you on knockout questions, keywords, and competencies. Hirecarta shows you that same view of every job before you apply. Import any posting in one click into an organized tracker and get a resume tailored to each job. The more you tell Hirecarta, the better every resume gets. Free trial. No card.

posts.name: District Assurance
posts.tagline: Open-source engine for trusted AI phone calls
posts.description: An open-source TypeScript engine for automated phone lines that handle accounts, payments and doors. The model on the call can ask; only your code can say yes. It verifies the caller, files what they confirm, texts a payment link and records every step.

posts.name: LearnXops Job Agent
posts.tagline: AI agent that finds jobs, tailors your résumé and applies
posts.description: Set the roles, seniority and locations you want. The Job Agent searches company career pages and job boards, scores each job against your profile, writes a tailored résumé and cover letter using only what is true in your profile, applies on employers' sites and logs it all in your Job Tracker. It hands you CAPTCHAs, sign-ins and questions only you can answer, and never applies on LinkedIn or Indeed. Runs in the LearnXops desktop app with your own AI provider. Pro and Lifetime.

posts.name: ShrinkLoop
posts.tagline: Shrink OpenAI, Claude & Gemini bills 75% on local silicon
posts.description: ShrinkLoop is a sovereign, 1-line drop-in proxy (OpenAI, Claude & Gemini) that runs inside your own VPC or on Apple Silicon. It verifies structured outputs (SQL, JSON, OpenAPI) deterministically, redacts PII before frontier escalations, trains compact ~12–20 MB LoRA specialists on Apple Silicon MLX or Linux NVIDIA CUDA with an anti-forgetting gate, and syncs adapters to iPhone/Android offline. Giant intelligence, compressed to your desk.

posts.name: Vinellu
posts.tagline: The social network made for people who love wine
posts.description: The social network made for wine lovers. Rate labels, follow friends, and discover your next wine through recommendations from real people

posts.name: YouGuide: Audio Tour Guide
posts.tagline: The audio guide that starts talking when you arrive
posts.description: Walk up to a place — a church, a waterfall, a street corner with forgotten history — and the audio guide just starts playing. No tapping, no QR code, screen can stay locked. 1,600+ places across 364 cities in 6 countries, in Spanish, English and Portuguese. 116 hand-built tours, a cultural agenda that updates daily, and real rewards at local businesses. Free, works offline. Just launched on Google Play — try it and leave a rating, I read every bit of feedback.

posts.name: Ladybird Agentic
posts.tagline: Native C++ browser for AI agents, hardened for humans
posts.description: Derived from Ladybird with an embedded C++ MCP server (58 tools + SSE), ephemeral containers, live tab migration, WebMCP, SEP-2640 Skills, AES-256-GCM Blind Vault, and Agent Security Shield v2 against prompt injection. Zero Chromium, zero CDP.

posts.name: Happy Wedding
posts.tagline: Turn your guest list into a wedding seating chart for free
posts.description: Import your guest list from Excel or CSV, arrange round, long or square tables, and drag guests into place. Try it without signing up, then save your plan with a free account. When the seating is set, a one-time Pro upgrade uses the same guest list to make matching, print-ready place cards and seating charts.

posts.name: Fleo by Flyweel
posts.tagline: Free, open-source multi-model agentic SEO/AEO content engine
posts.description: This one's for the people... We built an agentic SEO/AEO engine at Flyweel for our own growth. It took us from near zero to 9,000 search impressions in 60-90 days, so we open-sourced it for free. Bring your URL and an OpenRouter key (or per-step keys). Eight specialist models research live SERPs, Reddit, and Quora, strip every unverified link, and write articles built to rank on Google and get cited by AI search. Ships to any stack. Nothing to sell you. Have your agent steal it!

posts.name: Perplexity Context API
posts.tagline: Perplexity's API for full web page context, $1 per 1K URLs
posts.description: Perplexity Context API reads up to 10 URLs at once and returns clean Markdown, HTML, links and query-relevant snippets for each page. Content comes from Perplexity's web index or a live fetch, and you set how fresh it must be. Each URL has its own status, so one failure doesn't fail the rest. Per Perplexity, it returned usable content for 92.3% of test URLs. Pricing is $1 per 1,000 URLs, and only successful URLs are billed.

posts.name: PyUIBuilder
posts.tagline: Build your Python GUIs like Canva
posts.description: PyUiBuilder is a visual drag-and-drop GUI builder that makes creating Python desktop applications faster and easier. You can convert your existing script to GUI, edit your GUI and convert it to exe file.

posts.name: McBot Studio
posts.tagline: AI agents that stay yours
posts.description: Build a team of AI agents on your computer, with any model, local or cloud. Switch models in one click and your agents keep their memory. Free and open source.

posts.name: AI Usage Tracker
posts.tagline: Know what Claude and Codex cost you, by project and model
posts.description: Your AI coding has a real price. AI Usage Tracker reads the local logs of Claude Code, Codex CLI, Cursor and 7 more tools and prices every session at current API rates, Opus 5.5 to GPT-6.2. Spend by day, project and model. No cloud, no telemetry.

posts.name: Foldeo
posts.tagline: Collect client documents without the email chase
posts.description: Send clients one checklist in a branded portal. They upload or scan from their phone. See what’s missing, turn on automatic reminders, and accept files or request replacements in the same place.

posts.name: speedrun.watch
posts.tagline: New verified speedruns, posted to your Discord server
posts.description: Free Discord bot that notifies your server about new verified speedruns from speedrun.com. Track world records, top placements, and new runs for any game.

posts.name: ChurnWin
posts.tagline: Prioritize Stripe recovery by revenue at risk
posts.description: ChurnWin helps subscription teams find which Stripe failed payments and cancellation patterns put the most recurring revenue at risk. It groups customer feedback and ranks what to investigate next by monthly recurring revenue. Try the free recovery audit with your own figures before connecting Stripe.

posts.name: Kan Lazım
posts.tagline: Turkey's urgent blood request board, in Turkish
posts.description: Kan Lazım is a free, Turkish-language board for urgent blood requests across all 81 provinces of Turkey. Someone at a hospital posts a request in about a minute with no account; volunteer donors filter by city and blood type and call. Every request is moderated on the server, points to one of more than 1,500 real hospitals and retires after 72 hours. The patient's phone number is never public, and donors can get alerts for matching requests nearby. No ads, no trackers.

posts.name: LogRaker
posts.tagline: Death by a thousand terminal tabs, cured
posts.description: LogRaker is a native Mac app that tails your logs live from SSH servers, local files, Amazon CloudWatch, Amazon S3, Supabase and Google Cloud / Firebase. Put Streams side by side, read them in lock-step by time, and let Monitors tell you when something breaks, even on your Apple TV.

posts.name: outl
posts.tagline: Open source outliner with plain markdown files and P2P sync
posts.description: outl is a bullet outliner for people who like the Roam/Logseq workflow but don't want their notes locked in a database. Every page is a plainmd file in a folder you choose: no UUIDs, no id:: lines. Daily journal, [[links]] with backlinks, TODO/DOING/DONE, runnable code blocks, and an MCP server so Claude or Cursor can read and write your notes. Sync is P2P over iroh, end-to-end encrypted, no account, with a tree-CRDT merging offline edits. Desktop, terminal, iOS, Android. Free, MIT.

posts.name: BuildItOmi AI – Omi 0.1
posts.tagline: Made in India: our own AI model for chat, code and an API
posts.description: BuildItOmi AI · Omi 0.1 is our own AI model, made in India for the world. A 21B mixture-of-experts model (3.6B active) for English, Hindi and 10 more Indian languages, good at coding, app ideas and step-by-step reasoning. Chat and a standard chat-completions API on one BuildItOmi AI account. Access opens in waves from launch day: join the waitlist to get your place. Plans from $8/month; API credits from $5. Prices in USD.

posts.name: ChurnWin
posts.tagline: Prioritize Stripe recovery by revenue at risk
posts.description: ChurnWin helps subscription teams find which Stripe failed payments and cancellation patterns put the most recurring revenue at risk. It groups customer feedback and ranks what to investigate next by monthly recurring revenue. Try the free recovery audit with your own figures before connecting Stripe.

posts.name: Nixa
posts.tagline: Run and manage all your AI coding agents on your Mac
posts.description: Nixa is a free, open source Mac app that runs your AI coding agents for you. Start Claude Code, Codex, Gemini and more side by side, one space per project. Tell Nixa what you need by chat or voice. It picks the agent, gives it the job, has a second agent review the work, and tells you only what needs you. Also works from your Android phone over your own Wi-Fi. Beta.

posts.description: Build a team of AI agents on your computer, with any model, local or cloud. Switch models in one click and your agents keep their memory. Free and open source.

posts.name: Power Popups for SharePoint
posts.tagline: Attention-grabbing popups SharePoint cannot do natively
posts.description: Add targeted, scheduled popups and slide-in panels to modern SharePoint - the native modal capability SharePoint simply does not have. 7-day free trial.

posts.name: LinkSave - Save Button For LinkedIn
posts.tagline: A one-click Save button for LinkedIn
posts.description: I save a lot of posts on LinkedIn (hiring threads, good write-ups, things to read later), and it always takes three clicks: open the ⋯ menu, find Save, close the menu. On some posts I'd lose my place in the feed doing it. So I built LinkSave, a small Chrome extension that does two things: - Adds a Save button right after Send under every post. - Adds a "Saved" tab to the top bar, so your saved posts are one click away instead of buried in your profile menu.

posts.name: EaseAccess24
posts.tagline: Web Accessibility Compliance Platform
posts.description: EaseAccess24 DevTools is a free Chrome extension that adds an accessibility panel to Chrome DevTools. Run axe-core audits against WCAG 2.1 A and AA, see the page's landmarks and heading structure, inspect any element's ARIA role, check colour contrast with suggested fixes, inventory alt text, and simulate low vision. Built for developers and QA, simple enough for content and business teams. Everything runs locally in your browser: no page data leaves your device.

posts.name: Beachball Island
posts.tagline: Turn your Mac into an air hockey table
posts.description: The first game built for Touch on Mac! Play solo or duo. Compatible with trackpad, or with Sidecar iPads.

posts.name: Hilbase
posts.tagline: One memory for all your AI chats and decisions
posts.description: Don't lose that idea. Hilbase is one memory for all your AI chats and decisions. Map every idea, log every conversation: every dropped option keeps its reason, so nobody brings Berlin back blind. Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and any app that speaks MCP share the same trail. Your AI logs it as you talk, and tells you what it logged. No AI? Works by hand. Free during the beta.

posts.name: LeadTaro
posts.tagline: B2B Lead Generation, Data Enrichment, Sales Automation
posts.description: LeadTaro is an all-in-one B2B lead generation platform designed to help businesses, sales teams, marketers, agencies, and entrepreneurs find potential customers and grow their businesses more efficiently. With access to millions of business records, LeadTaro makes it easier to discover targeted prospects, collect valuable business information, and build high-quality sales pipelines without spending hours on manual research. https://www.leadtaro.com

posts.name: YuanYu Mosque
posts.tagline: A peaceful virtual mosque for prayer and reflection anywhere
posts.description: Discover a peaceful virtual mosque where you can pause, reflect, and reconnect with your faith. Explore an immersive 3D mosque, experience a quiet space for prayer and reflection, and take a moment away from the busyness of everyday life — all from your browser, without downloading an app or creating an account. Whether you're traveling, living far from a mosque, or simply looking for a peaceful moment, YuanYu Virtual Mosque offers a welcoming space you can visit anytime, anywhere.

posts.name: War Atlas
posts.tagline: 12,000 battles and 66 animated campaigns on one map
posts.description: War Atlas puts nearly 12,000 battles on a present-day map, from 1500 BCE to today. Watch 66 campaigns unfold day by day, follow a book or film stop by stop, and see what was fought near you or on this date. Free, no sign-up.

posts.name: Sliver
posts.tagline: The smallest, lightest mini browser
posts.description: Sliver turns any website into a small floating window that stays on top of your other Mac apps. No tabs, no switching.

posts.name: RowTidy
posts.tagline: Turn messy supplier PDFs and CSVs into clean Shopify catalog
posts.description: Turn invoices into products in seconds. RowTidy automates catalog onboarding, so you never have to copy and paste. Drop an invoice or CSV, and our AI extracts identifiers, verifies data against brand portals, and pushes clean products to your channel. Parser: Extracts EANs and MPNs from PDFs and CSVs. Verification: Cross-references brand sources to prevent errors. Image Locking: Pulls high-res images from authorized portals. Shopify Sync: Automatically formats variants and attributes.

posts.name: NammaRide
posts.tagline: Fare Calculator, Live Tracking & Timings,Explore , Tickting
posts.description: NammaRide is the #1 offline Geo GPS transit navigation application for Bengaluru Namma Metro (BMRCL). Features Bangalore Metro Fare Calculator with Smart Card discounts, Nearest Metro Station Radar from live location, Live Train Tracking Map, and Timetable schedules in English and Kannada.

posts.name: Lidwork
posts.tagline: Close the lid. Your Mac and your agent keep working.
posts.description: Keeps a MacBook awake with the lid closed, on battery, so coding agents, builds and uploads finish. Stops at your battery limit, when it gets too hot, or after 1, 4 or 8 hours. If it quits or crashes, sleep comes back. Free on the Mac App Store through Cyber Monday (Dec 1), then $9.99 once.

posts.name: Vesper
posts.tagline: Understand your competitors
posts.description: Vesper researches a company and up to 4 competitors from public sources (website, SEO, ad libraries, social, app stores, Reddit). It shows how each one grows, what changed since the last check, and where the market is underserved, with an experiment for each gap. Every insight cites its evidence, and anything it couldn't check is marked "Not checked". Open source (MIT) and self-hostable with Docker.

posts.name: HeicFix
posts.tagline: HEIC to JPG in one tap, right on your iPhone
posts.description: iPhone photos are saved as HEIC, which Windows, Android and many upload forms can't open. HeicFix converts them to JPG, PNG or PDF in one tap, shrinks a photo to the exact KB limit a visa or job portal asks for, and combines scans into one PDF. Works from the Photos share sheet and in batches. Everything happens on your iPhone: nothing is uploaded, it works offline and can strip location data. Your first photo is free.

posts.name: CC Harness Studio
posts.tagline: Design, simulate & verify Claude Code / AGENTS.md harnesses
posts.description: Sharpen Your Harness Design. CC Harness Studio turns scattered AGENTS.md, skills and hooks into one graph: wire agents visually, simulate context token budgets, compile bounded autonomous loops, and test hooks. 100% local, Git-native, open source.

posts.name: Casthop
posts.tagline: Open-source live studio you can self-host
posts.description: Casthop is a browser live studio like StreamYard, but open source. Bring guests on stage, stream to YouTube, Twitch and more at once, record each person on their own track, clip the last 60 seconds, and add a vertical 9:16 version. Self-host it for free.

posts.name: TonoCam
posts.tagline: An iPhone camera with live film looks and manual controls
posts.description: TonoCam brings film-inspired looks to your iPhone viewfinder, so you can see the color and contrast before you shoot. Set shutter speed, ISO, white balance and focus for photos and video. Explore Burst, Time-Lapse, Slow Shutter, Slow Motion and Multiple Exposure. With Pro, keep the original and an editable recipe with digital negatives, capture RAW on supported cameras, and export TIFF.

posts.name: Fit Brains 2.0
posts.tagline: Personalized Brain Training
posts.description: Fit Brains 2.0 is a relaunch of the original Fit Brains, the brain training app used by more than 18 million people and covered by The New York Times, The Wall Street Journal and The Guardian. Fit Brains 2.0 is all new: 35 games that focus on memory, focus, problem solving, words, numbers and more, each one adapting to your level. A short daily workout is picked for you, and charts and insights tools show where you're strong and where to focus next.

posts.name: Got My PDF
posts.tagline: 118+ Free Tools for PDFs, Images, Excel & More
posts.description: One place for 118+ free tools to work with PDFs, images, Excel spreadsheets, documents and more. Convert, compress, merge, split, sign, OCR and handle everyday file tasks with a privacy-first approach. No uploads, no sign-up and no watermarks. Many tools work offline, with files processed directly on your device.

posts.name: Pawstop
posts.tagline: Plan road-trip stops for your dog along your route
posts.description: Pawstop helps you find places to take a break with your dog along the drive you’re already planning. Enter your start and destination, choose how often you want to stop, and set a detour limit. Pawstop suggests stops near each planned break, shows how much driving they add, and explains why it picked them. Open a suggested stop in Google Maps when you’re ready to go.

posts.name: Vastralook
posts.tagline: AI Garment Photoshoot Studio
posts.description: AI garment photoshoot studio: one flat garment photo becomes studio-quality on-model photos, with a Drape Studio for sarees and a Catalogue Studio for every other garment.

posts.name: RemRent
posts.tagline: Find a rental in Brazil by what the photos show
posts.description: RemRent is AI-powered rental search for Brazil. It merges duplicate ads into one card per home, turns what's in the photos into filters (furniture, balcony, view) and adds rent, condo fee and property tax into one monthly cost. 350K+ homes in six cities (for now).

posts.name: QR-Studio
posts.tagline: QR Code Generator & Scanner Browser Extension
posts.description: Discover QR-Studio, a browser extension for generating custom QR codes, scanning QR codes from images or your screen, and managing scan history. Available for Chrome and Firefox.

posts.name: Pronouns in Maps
posts.tagline: Vote on the pronouns for the world’s cities, oceans and seas
posts.description: A map where anyone can vote on the pronouns of about 4,750 cities, oceans and seas. Pick as many as fit from every set in the Gender Census 2025, and see tags like she/they appear on the map. No accounts, and IP addresses are never stored. A Tampermonkey overlay also shows the results on Google Maps. Inspired by the "woke is back" euphoria after the 2026 midterms.

posts.name: HackYourWayIn
posts.tagline: Hands-on Ethical Hacking Labs
posts.description: Hands-on capture-the-flag labs built on real vulnerable Linux servers, ready in seconds.

posts.name: Termexo Fleet
posts.tagline: Orchestrate AI coding tasks across your machines
posts.description: Termexo Fleet is a local-first desktop app that coordinates coding tasks across your existing Termexo workbenches. Route jobs by difficulty to configured machines and models, run implementation and testing in dependency order, and inspect or take over live terminals from one screen. Parallel sub-agents can use separate Git worktrees. MIT-licensed and available for Windows, macOS, and Linux.

posts.name: Dev Toolkit
posts.tagline: All-in-One Desktop Developer Tools
posts.description: Discover Dev Toolkit, a lightweight native desktop application featuring formatters, converters, network diagnostics, system monitoring, and productivity tools—all in one place.

posts.name: getMax
posts.tagline: Get found. Get leads. Get Max.
posts.description: getMax is the AI marketing team for small businesses: 9 specialized agents, led by Max, in one app. They build and update your website, improve your visibility on Google and in AI search, write and schedule your articles and social posts, run your Google Ads and email campaigns, and follow up every lead in a built-in CRM. You approve everything before it goes live. Free plan, no credit card.

posts.name: KollegeX
posts.tagline: India's college search: zero spam, zero paid rankings
posts.description: Free, AI-powered college discovery for India. Search and compare 18,500+ colleges with no login, then use the rank predictor (17 exams) and AI counsellor with a free sign-up. No paid rankings, no data selling, no spam calls.

posts.name: Mausam Robu
posts.tagline: A cute weather companion at your desk
posts.description: Mausam Robu is a small desk display that shows live weather, air quality (AQI, PM2.5, PM10) and official alerts for your location. Its face changes with the sky: happy in sun, sad in rain, shocked by a storm. No app, no subscription. Designed and built in Bengaluru.

posts.name: FrameKit
posts.tagline: Take Mac screenshots & screen recordings to the next level
posts.description: Capture, mark up, and record straight from your Mac menu bar. Style screenshots with framed backgrounds and mockups, polish recordings in Studio with auto zoom and captions, and share via your own cloud bucket.
